items.title: Know Before You Go – Georgia State
items.summary: Marshall Football returns to Joan C. Edwards Stadium at 4 p.m. on Saturday for its final home game of the 2026 season against Georgia State. Here's all you need to Know Before You Go to The Joan this Saturday!

items.title: Marshall Football Announces Fan Appreciation Promotions For Saturday
items.summary: Marshall Athletics is inviting Herd Nation to Joan C. Edwards Stadium for one final home football game of the 2026 season as the Thundering Herd hosts Georgia State on Saturday, November 21, at 4 p.m. With Fan Appreciation Day, special ticket promotions, Senior Day and Salute to Service recognitions, Saturday offers something for fans of all ages as Marshall closes out its home schedule.

items.title: Marshall Football’s Season Finale Vs. ULM Set For 1 p.m.
items.summary: Marshall Football's Nov. 28 contest at ULM will be a 1 p.m. ET/Noon CT kickoff at Malone Stadium and be shown on ESPN+, it was announced on Monday. The announcement at the 12-day window comes as part of the television contract between the Sun Belt Conference and ESPN.

items.title: Marshall Football Announces Offensive Staff Change
items.summary: Marshall Football head coach Tony Gibson announced a change to his staff on Sunday morning. Gunter Brewer, who has served as associate head coach/tight ends coach/inside receivers coach, will take over as interim offensive coordinator for the final two regular season games of the 2026 season.

items.title: Marshall Football Falls To App State, 20-16
items.summary: Marshall Football got three takeaways on the defensive side of the football, but could not hold off a second-half surge from App State in a 20-16 loss in front of 23,675 fans at Joan C. Edwards Stadium on Saturday night.

items.title: Marshall Football Hosts App State At 6 p.m. On Saturday
items.summary: Marshall Football hosts its annual '75' game against App State at 6 p.m. on Saturday from Joan C. Edwards Stadium. The game, which will be shown on ESPN+, falls on the 56th anniversary of the 1970 Marshall Plane Crash in which 75 persons aboard Southern Airways Flight 932 perished upon re-entry to Tri-State Airport following the Herd's 17-14 loss to East Carolina.

items.title: Know Before You Go – App State
items.summary: Marshall Football returns to Joan C. Edwards Stadium on Saturday, November 14, as the Thundering Herd hosts Appalachian State at 6 p.m. on ESPN+. Saturday marks the 56th anniversary of the November 14, 1970, plane crash that claimed the lives of 75 Marshall football players, coaches, staff, supporters and flight crew members. items.title: Marshall Football Falls To Georgia Southern, 49-13
items.summary: Marshall Football dropped a 49-13 contest at Georgia Southern in front of a Homecoming crowd of 24,023 fans at Allen E. Paulson Stadium on Saturday.

items.title: Marshall Football Battles Georgia Southern At 3:30 p.m. On Saturday
items.summary: Marshall Football looks for its third straight win on Saturday when the team travels to take on Georgia Southern in a 3:30 p.m. contest that will be shown on ESPN+ from Paulson Stadium in Statesboro, Ga.
